data_minimization_notes: Photos of the fridge/pantry are sent to Anthropic for AI vision and then discarded on our side; we do not persist the raw image bytes.
Voice input is transcribed on-device by iOS Speech Recognition; only the resulting text is transmitted for the duration of a cooking-mode turn.
Sentry beforeSend strips email|password|token|transcript|raw_query|prompt|display_name|name keys before transmission.
Server-side logs emit IDs and counts only — no emails, prompts, or transcripts.
